fusions.name: Drift Throw
fusions.desc: A thrown blow that deals 5 damage, up to 1.5 times that at the maximum range of 6 tiles, with a 40% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow Tide
fusions.desc: A heavy swing that deals 12 damage to everything within 2.5 tiles ahead of you and knocks it back 2.5 tiles; each hit has a 50% chance to leave the target [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Gentle Pulse
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 4 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

fusions.name: Easy Does It
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 3 health a second for 6 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
